name: @thetis/compaction
description: Automatic context compaction: summarizes the older part of a long conversation into one note when the next request nears the model's window, keeps the recent tail verbatim, and never edits the record.

thetis.label: compaction
thetis.summary: Keeps long conversations going by summarising their older part when they grow too long.

enabled.help: Compact automatically when the next request would exceed threshold × window. Off, an existing summary is still sent until it is reset from the Compaction dock.

threshold.help: The fraction of the model's context window at which compaction starts. Well before 1.0: at the window the provider refuses the request.

window.help: The most context, in tokens, compaction ever plans against: a model that reports a smaller window uses its own, one that reports more (a 1M model) is compacted as if it had this. Also the window assumed for a model the provider reports none for.

windows.help: Per-model windows in tokens, keyed by model id or id prefix (longest key wins), taken as they are: the way to let one model run past `window`, for example { "anthropic/claude-opus": 400000 }.

keepTokens.help: How much of the most recent conversation, in estimated tokens, is always sent verbatim after the summary.

minShedTokens.help: A compaction that would summarize less than this, in estimated tokens, is not worth breaking the prompt cache for and is skipped.

summaryModel.help: The model that writes the summary. Unset means the conversation's own model, which reads the cached prefix and so costs only the summary; a different model re-reads the whole history at full price.

summaryMaxTokens.help: max_tokens of the summarization request: its own output budget, not the conversation's. Reasoning counts against it on models that think.

summaryReasoning.help: Let the model think while it writes the summary, as the conversation does. Off sends reasoning: { enabled: false }, so the whole output budget goes to the summary; a model that must think refuses that, and on Anthropic models a change of thinking setting re-reads the history at full price instead of from the cache.

summaryTimeoutMs.help: How long one summarization request may take before it is abandoned and counted as a failure. Keep it under the fence's 300 s step deadline.

maxFailures.help: Consecutive failed attempts after which automatic compaction pauses for the conversation. The Compaction panel says so and has a Resume button; a manual request also tries again.

dock.label: Compaction
dock.hint: How full this chat's memory is, and what has been summarized

commands.label: Read the context and compaction state of a conversation
Ask for a compaction at the start of the next message
Send the full history again from the next message
Start automatic compaction again after it paused
